citation.title: Smoking in relation to early dental implant failure: A systematic review and meta-analysis
citation.authors: Ying-Ying Fan, Shu Li, Ye-Jun Cai, Tai Wei, Peng Ye

s_design.evidence_quote: To assess the association between smoking and early dental implant failure by conducting a systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies.

domains.evidence_quote: This systematic review and meta-analysis was registered at the PROSPERO database (registration number CRD42024561240).

A comprehensive systematic search of the literature published between database inception and June 30, 2024 was performed, without language restriction, in five databases: PubMed, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, and Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials.

The initial systematic database search yielded 4650 citations, from which 1062 articles were excluded owing to duplication. The remaining 3588 records were screened by title and/or abstract for relevance, and 3509 records were excluded. Of the remaining 79 full-text articles, 29 articles met the inclusion criteria and were included for further systematic review and meta-analysis

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.evidence_quote: Using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale (NOS) for observational studies, two authors (YYF and SL) conducted separate evaluations of the methodological quality of the eligible studies (Material S2).
Summary ORs were pooled using generic random effect meta-analysis with inverse-variance weighting.
Publication bias was evaluated using the Egger test and graphically by using a funnel plot.
